verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an email-automation platform, for example scheduled or recurring sends or timed workflows, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only event-driven triggers (webhooks, WebSockets), one-off message sends, drafts, and third-party workflow tools such as Sim. None of these is a recurring schedule AgentMail itself provides. Workflows built in Sim or Zapier are adjacent or user-side and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
